alt.en: A large violet gauge, its needle near the top of its arc, stands at the center of a gray floor. A dashed orange line with two packets runs into it from a screen of text on the left, and a solid orange arrow leads from it to a phone on the right. A sheet of code lies in front, joined to the gauge by a dotted indigo line.
alt.zh: 画面中央是一只大号紫色仪表盘，指针接近刻度顶端。左侧屏幕上的文字沿一条带两个数据包的橙色虚线进入仪表盘，一条橙色实线箭头从仪表盘指向右侧的手机；前方平放一张代码纸，以靛蓝点线连到仪表盘。

caption.en: Illustration: a runtime check, drawn as a gauge, measures a natural-language intent from a screen against a specification sheet before an action reaches a device. It does not depict SafeOrchestrate's architecture or any tested deployment, and it does not show that the checks work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：仪表盘代表运行时检查，对照规约纸张衡量屏幕上的自然语言意图，再将动作发往设备。图中并非 SafeOrchestrate 的架构或任何经过测试的部署，也不表明这些检查如所述那样有效。
